result.instructions: Tools for BulkSMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many SMS credits do I have left in my account?"; "Show the text messages we sent since yesterday and their delivery status."; "Did anyone reply to the text I sent this morning?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BulkSMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bulksms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bulksms_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bulksms_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. bulksms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bulksms_get_profile
tools.title: Get account profile and credits
tools.description: Show the BulkSMS account: username, credit balance, credit limit, whether credit transfer is allowed, the daily message quota (size and remaining today) and the sender ids this account may use. Company and billing details are left out. BulkSMS REST: GET /profile.

tools.name: bulksms_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List sent (SENT) and received (RECEIVED) SMS messages, newest first by default. BulkSMS limits the window to the last 7 days unless submission_date_from is given. To page newest-first, pass before_id = the smallest id of the previous page; with sort_order ASCENDING pass after_id = the largest id of the previous page. REST: GET /messages with a `filter` built from the arguments.

status_id.description: Filter by full status id, e.g. FAILED.BLOCKED or FAILED.EXPIRED.

submission_id.description: Only messages of this submission (the submission.id of a sent message).

submission_date_from.description: Only messages submitted at or after this time, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

user_supplied_id.description: The userSuppliedId you set when sending (SENT messages only).

before_id.description: Only messages with an id lower than this (older), for paging.

after_id.description: Only messages with an id higher than this (newer), for paging with sort_order ASCENDING: pass the largest id of the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages, default 50. The API may return fewer even if more exist: page with before_id.

tools.name: bulksms_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: Get one sent or received message by its id: body, recipient, delivery status, number of parts and credit cost. BulkSMS REST: GET /messages/{id}.

message_id.description: The message id (from list_messages or send_message).

tools.name: bulksms_list_replies
tools.title: List replies to a sent message
tools.description: List the received (RECEIVED) replies linked to a sent message id. Only messages sent with a REPLIABLE sender have linked replies. An empty list means none or an unknown id. BulkSMS REST: GET /messages/{id}/relatedReceivedMessages.

message_id.description: The id of the SENT message.

annotations.title: List replies to a sent message

tools.name: bulksms_list_blocked_numbers
tools.title: List blocked numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers the account may not send to (added via the API, by a recipient replying STOP, or by BulkSMS). To page, pass min_id = the largest id of the previous page + 1. BulkSMS REST: GET /blocked-numbers.

tools.name: bulksms_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the account's webhooks (name, trigger SENT/RECEIVED, active flag, invoke option). Only the host of each webhook URL is shown: the path and query can hold a secret. Read-only: webhooks are not changed by this server. BulkSMS REST: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: bulksms_send_message
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL SMS to real people and SPENDS CREDITS from the user's BulkSMS account; it cannot be undone or recalled. One message text to 1 to 10 phone numbers in international format (e.g. +447700900000). Cost = credits per message part x number of parts x number of recipients (about 1 credit per 160-character GSM part to a standard-route destination; the exact cost depends on the destination and appears as creditCost on the sent messages afterwards). Messages longer than one part are concatenated up to max_parts parts (default 3). Non-GSM characters (emoji, accents outside GSM 03.38) are replaced by "?" unless auto_unicode is true, which sends Unicode (shorter parts, more credits). Messages to blocked numbers still cost credits. Only send what the user explicitly asked for, confirm the text and recipients first. No groups, no scheduling. Texts containing BulkSMS template placeholders such as {F0###}, {fn###} or {sn###} are rejected (they would merge contact data). BulkSMS REST: POST /messages.

to.description: 1 to 10 recipient numbers in international format with country code, e.g. +447700900000 or 27831234567.

from.description: Optional sender id: an allowed international number or a short alphanumeric name (see get_profile originAddresses). Omit to use the account default.

auto_unicode.description: If true, a text with characters outside GSM 03.38 is sent as Unicode instead of having them replaced by '?'. Default false.

max_parts.description: Cap on concatenated parts (and so on cost per recipient). Default 3.

user_supplied_id.description: Your own reference (max 20 characters) stored on the messages, usable as a filter in list_messages.

tools.name: bulksms_block_number
tools.title: Block a phone number
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE phone number to the account's blocked list, so that no further messages are sent to it (a send to a blocked number fails with FAILED.BLOCKED and still costs credits). This API has no way to remove a block again: do it only when the user asks for it. BulkSMS REST: POST /blocked-numbers.

phone_number.description: The number in international format, e.g. +447700900000 or 447700900000.
